events.text: A rumour spreads: a lost manual lies in a ruined temple in the hills.

effects.log: Half the jianghu has the same idea.
Rumours rarely train anyone.

events.text: The ruined temple is crowded with treasure hunters digging everywhere.

choices.text: Read the old carvings for clues

ok.log: The clue points under the bell. You find a sealed box first.

choices.text: Help an old monk who is being pushed around

effects.log: He is the temple's last guardian. He remembers.

events.text: Two hunters fight over a box they found. It is empty.

effects.log: They stop, embarrassed, and share their dried meat.
They exhaust each other. You find the real hiding place.

events.text: Hawkers sell 'the lost manual' outside the temple. Ten different versions.

effects.log: Chapter one: "Breathe." (−1 taels)
You save a few from wasting their silver.

events.text: At night, a masked guardian attacks anyone near the temple bell.

ok.log: You win. The guardian unmasks: the old monk, testing your heart.

fail.log: The guardian is far stronger. You wake at dawn, bruised, with a note: "Not yet."

effects.log: It lowers its staff and listens.

events.text: The monk reveals the truth: the 'manual' is a single page with one sentence.

effects.log: 'Train every day, and help those who cannot.' You laugh, then stop laughing.
Some mysteries are worth keeping.

events.text: A rival treasure hunter offers to split whatever you find.

effects.log: You find nothing. You find a friend.
You search alone, faster and lonelier.

events.text: The treasure hunters have wrecked the temple. The old monk weeps.

effects.log: A week of work. The monk teaches you in the evenings.
Shamed, they rebuild it better than before.

events.text: You find an old book in the attic and decide it is a secret martial manual.

effects.log: It is a cookbook. You are very good at stirring now.
Your treasure. Nobody else must know.

events.text: A cave behind the temple, with sword marks all over the walls.

effects.log: A master trained here alone for years. You follow their path.
Someday someone will study yours.

events.text: A merchant claims to have the real manual and auctions it in the town square.

effects.log: The crowd turns on him.
A rich fool pays a fortune for a copy of the Analects.

events.text: The rumour dies. The hunters go home. The temple is quiet again.

effects.log: He gives you a real breathing method, small and true.
The best manual is practice.
